title: Dua of the Day
arabicDua: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ ذَنْبِيْ كُلَّهُ ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
transliteration: Allāhumma-ghfir lī dhambī kullah, diqqahū wa jillah, wa awwalahū wa ākhirah, wa ʿalāniyatahū wa sirrah.
translation: O Allah, forgive for me all of my sins: the minor and major, the first and the last, the public and the private.

title: Supplication to one who does you a favour
translation: ‘If someone does you a favour and you say: ‘May Allah reward you with goodness.’ then you have indeed excelled in praising him.’
